page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.c8i.8xlarge is an x86_64 architecture server instance powered by an Intel Xeon 8475B processor running at 2.7 GHz. It features 32 dedicated physical cores with 32 vCPUs, operating with a 1.0 thread-per-core ratio. The instance is provisioned with 64.0 GB of system memory, establishing a 2.0 GB memory-per-core ratio.

This server type utilizes the KVM hypervisor and does not include local storage, requiring external block storage volumes for persistent data. Network connectivity is supported by a baseline bandwidth of 20 Gbps. It does not include complimentary public IPv4 addresses or integrated GPU hardware.

The 1:2 vCPU-to-RAM ratio positions this instance as a compute-optimized resource. The dedicated core allocation ensures consistent CPU execution without resource sharing, though the lack of local storage and moderate memory density are key tradeoffs. This configuration is designed for compute-heavy workloads such as batch processing, web serving, and application servers that do not require massive in-memory databases or local NVMe storage.
